notes: Steps run MME's own frmMain procedures cut from frmMain.frm. The map drawing is not run: MapDrawOnRoom is blanked, MapMapExits' call of MapActivateCell answers -1 (no cell is activated), and the tooltip text is read from objToolTip.SetToolTipItem (read %tip).

The oracle database holds a subset of Rooms (db_only pairs); data.rooms is the same rows for the Rust test. Other tables are whole in the oracle; data holds the names and records the cases can reach.

FindRoomWithDirections: frmPopUpOptions.Show is replaced by setting Tag from frmMain.txtRoomFindOk (1 = OK, -1 = cancel); the name, match mode and direction buttons are the case's frmPopUpOptions controls. Results are frmResults.lvResults.
cmdMapFindText_Click: InputBox answers come from the case's inputbox list; MapStartMapping is recorded as an event (its arguments are the hit); MsgBox texts are recorded events.
GetLairInfo answers from data.lairs; the damage arrays are -1 except where a case sets them.
Rows numbered 9001 and up (rooms of maps 9001 and 9002, monster 9002, textblocks 20201 to 20203) are invented.
